 describe('Parse Body Util', () => {
   const FORM_URL = 'https://localhost/form'
@@ -50,6 +51,259 @@ describe('Parse Body Util', () => {
     })
   })
 
+  it('should parse dotted multipart form fields as nested objects with dot true', async () => {
+    const data = new FormData()
+    data.append('account.name', 'Alice')
+    data.append('account.email', 'alice@example.com')
+    data.append('token', 'abc123')
+
+    const req = createRequest(FORM_URL, 'POST', data)
+
+    const parsedData = await parseBody(req, { dot: true })
+    expect(parsedData.account).toEqual({
+      name: 'Alice',
+      email: 'alice@example.com',
+    })
+    expect(parsedData.token).toBe('abc123')
+  })
+
+  it('should parse deep dotted form fields with dot true', async () => {
+    const data = new FormData()
+    data.append('settings.profile.display.name', 'Ada')
+
+    const req = createRequest(FORM_URL, 'POST', data)
+
+    const parsedData = await parseBody(req, { dot: true })
+    expect(parsedData.settings).toEqual({
+      profile: { display: { name: 'Ada' } },
+    })
+  })
+
+  it('should parse dotted urlencoded fields as nested objects with dot true', async () => {
+    const params = new URLSearchParams()
+    params.append('profile.name', 'Grace')
+    params.append('profile.email', 'grace@example.com')
+
+    const req = new Request(FORM_URL, {
+      method: 'POST',
+      headers: {
+        'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
+      },
+      body: params,
+    })
+
+    const parsedData = await parseBody(req, { dot: true })
+    expect(parsedData.profile).toEqual({
+      name: 'Grace',
+      email: 'grace@example.com',
+    })
+  })
+
+  it('should pass dot option through request context parseBody', async () => {
+    const app = new Hono()
+    app.post('/profile', async (c) => {
+      const body = await c.req.parseBody({ dot: true })
+      return c.json(body)
+    })
+
+    const data = new FormData()
+    data.append('member.name', 'Lin')
+    data.append('member.role', 'admin')
+
+    const res = await app.request('/profile', {
+      method: 'POST',
+      body: data,
+    })
+
+    expect(await res.json()).toEqual({
+      member: {
+        name: 'Lin',
+        role: 'admin',
+      },
+    })
+  })
+
+  it('should preserve File values in nested paths', async () => {
+    const avatar = new File(['avatar'], 'avatar.png', {
+      type: 'image/png',
+    })
+    const resume = new File(['resume'], 'resume.pdf', {
+      type: 'application/pdf',
+    })
+    const data = new FormData()
+    data.append('uploads.avatar', avatar)
+    data.append('uploads.resume', resume)
+
+    const req = createRequest(FORM_URL, 'POST', data)
+
+    const parsedData = await parseBody(req, { dot: true })
+    expect((parsedData.uploads as Record<string, File>).avatar).toMatchObject({
+      name: 'avatar.png',
+      size: avatar.size,
+      type: 'image/png',
+    })
+    expect((parsedData.uploads as Record<string, File>).resume).toMatchObject({
+      name: 'resume.pdf',
+      size: resume.size,
+      type: 'application/pdf',
+    })
+  })
+
+  it('should keep dotted keys flat by default', async () => {
+    const data = new FormData()
+    data.append('account.name', 'Alice')
+
+    const req = createRequest(FORM_URL, 'POST', data)
+
+    const parsedData = await parseBody(req)
+    expect(parsedData['account.name']).toBe('Alice')
+    expect(parsedData.account).toBeUndefined()
+  })
+
+  it('should keep dotted keys flat when dot is false', async () => {
+    const data = new FormData()
+    data.append('account.name', 'Alice')
+
+    const req = createRequest(FORM_URL, 'POST', data)
+
+    const parsedData = await parseBody(req, { dot: false })
+    expect(parsedData['account.name']).toBe('Alice')
+    expect(parsedData.account).toBeUndefined()
+  })
+
+  it('should keep dotted keys flat with all only', async () => {
+    const data = new FormData()
+    data.append('account.name', 'Alice')
+    data.append('account.name', 'Ada')
+
+    const req = createRequest(FORM_URL, 'POST', data)
+
+    const parsedData = await parseBody(req, { all: true })
+    expect(parsedData['account.name']).toEqual(['Alice', 'Ada'])
+    expect(parsedData.account).toBeUndefined()
+  })
+
+  it('should combine dot true with all true for repeated dotted fields', async () => {
+    const data = new FormData()
+    data.append('prefs.tags', 'typescript')
+    data.append('prefs.tags', 'runtime')
+    data.append('scope', 'public')
+
+    const req = createRequest(FORM_URL, 'POST', data)
+
+    const parsedData = await parseBody(req, { dot: true, all: true })
+    expect(parsedData.prefs).toEqual({
+      tags: ['typescript', 'runtime'],
+    })
+    expect(parsedData.scope).toBe('public')
+  })
+
+  it('should combine dot true with array suffix fields', async () => {
+    const data = new FormData()
+    data.append('settings.roles[]', 'admin')
+    data.append('settings.roles[]', 'editor')
+
+    const req = createRequest(FORM_URL, 'POST', data)
+
+    const parsedData = await parseBody(req, { dot: true })
+    expect(parsedData.settings).toEqual({
+      'roles[]': ['admin', 'editor'],
+    })
+  })
+
+  it('should return null prototype body objects', async () => {
+    const data = new FormData()
+    data.append('name', 'Alice')
+
+    const req = createRequest(FORM_URL, 'POST', data)
+
+    const parsedData = await parseBody(req)
+    expect(Object.getPrototypeOf(parsedData)).toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it('should return null prototype nested body objects with dot true', async () => {
+    const data = new FormData()
+    data.append('account.profile.name', 'Alice')
+
+    const req = createRequest(FORM_URL, 'POST', data)
+
+    const parsedData = await parseBody(req, { dot: true })
+    const account = parsedData.account as Record<string, unknown>
+    const profile = account.profile as Record<string, unknown>
+    expect(Object.getPrototypeOf(parsedData)).toBeNull()
+    expect(Object.getPrototypeOf(account)).toBeNull()
+    expect(Object.getPrototypeOf(profile)).toBeNull()
+    expect(profile.name).toBe('Alice')
+
+    for (const repeatedData of [new FormData(), new URLSearchParams()]) {
+      repeatedData.append('account', 'first')
+      repeatedData.append('account', 'second')
+      repeatedData.append('account.profile.name', 'Alice')
+
+      const repeatedParsed = await parseBody(
+        new Request(FORM_URL, { method: 'POST', body: repeatedData }),
+        { dot: true, all: true }
+      )
+      const repeatedAccount = repeatedParsed.account as Record<string, unknown>
+      const repeatedProfile = repeatedAccount.profile as Record<string, unknown>
+      expect(Object.getPrototypeOf(repeatedParsed)).toBeNull()
+      expect(Object.getPrototypeOf(repeatedAccount)).toBeNull()
+      expect(Object.getPrototypeOf(repeatedProfile)).toBeNull()
+      expect(repeatedProfile.name).toBe('Alice')
+    }
+  })
+
+  it('should expose types for dot options and nested body data', async () => {
+    const opts: Partial<ParseBodyOptions> = { dot: true }
+    const body: BodyData = {
+      account: {
+        name: 'Alice',
+      },
+    }
+    const req = createRequest(FORM_URL, 'POST', new FormData())
+    const parsed: BodyData = await parseBody(req, opts)
+
+    expect(opts.dot).toBe(true)
+    expect((body.account as Record<string, unknown>).name).toBe('Alice')
+    expect(Object.keys(parsed)).toEqual([])
+  })
+
+  it('should parse the Deno build of parseBody the same as src with every option', async () => {
+    // deno_dist is the build that Deno users import; it must not drift from src.
+    const deno = await vi.importActual<{ parseBody: typeof parseBody }>(
+      '../../deno_dist/utils/body'
+    )
+
+    const makeData = () => {
+      const data = new FormData()
+      data.append('file', 'aaa')
+      data.append('file', 'bbb')
+      data.append('message', 'hello')
+      data.append('tags[]', 'x')
+      data.append('tags[]', 'y')
+      data.append('account.name', 'Alice')
+      data.append('account.name', 'Ada')
+      return data
+    }
+
+    const defaults = await deno.parseBody(createRequest(FORM_URL, 'POST', makeData()))
+    expect(defaults.file).toBe('bbb')
+    expect(defaults['account.name']).toBe('Ada')
+
+    for (const options of [
+      undefined,
+      {},
+      { all: false },
+      { all: true },
+      { dot: true },
+      { all: true, dot: true },
+    ] as (Partial<ParseBodyOptions> | undefined)[]) {
+      const fromSrc = await parseBody(createRequest(FORM_URL, 'POST', makeData()), options)
+      const fromDeno = await deno.parseBody(createRequest(FORM_URL, 'POST', makeData()), options)
+      expect(fromDeno).toStrictEqual(fromSrc)
+    }
+  })
+
   it('should parse multiple values if `all` option is true', async () => {
     const data = new FormData()
     data.append('file', 'aaa')

@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+set -uo pipefail
+cd /testbed
+
+
+dev-switch node 22
+npm install --legacy-peer-deps 2>&1 | tail -1
+
+
+case "${1:-}" in
+  base)
+    npx vitest run src/utils/body.test.ts --testNamePattern 'should parse `multipart/form-data`|should parse `x-www-form-urlencoded`|should not parse multiple values in default|should parse multiple values if `all` option is true|should parse multiple values if values are `File`|should parse multiple values if key ends with `\[\]`|should return blank object if body is JSON'
+    ;;
+  new)
+    npx vitest run src/utils/body.test.ts --testNamePattern 'should parse dotted multipart form fields as nested objects with dot true|should parse deep dotted form fields with dot true|should parse dotted urlencoded fields as nested objects with dot true|should pass dot option through request context parseBody|should preserve File values in nested paths|should keep dotted keys flat by default|should keep dotted keys flat when dot is false|should keep dotted keys flat with all only|should combine dot true with all true for repeated dotted fields|should combine dot true with array suffix fields|should return null prototype body objects|should return null prototype nested body objects with dot true|should expose types for dot options and nested body data|should parse the Deno build of parseBody the same as src with every option'
+    ;;
+  *)
+    echo "usage: $0 base|new"
+    exit 2
+    ;;
+esac

rationale: Adds one Vitest case, in the file the grader already runs, that loads the Deno build (deno_dist/utils/body.ts) and requires it to parse the same form as src for every option combination. The recorded mutant changes only the Deno build's default (all = false -> true); the merged repair imported src only, so it passed the repaired Vitest parent. The Deno test runner and the TypeScript type check are not run by this grader and remain unrepaired.
